definitions.core_proxy: Looting/property destruction + Other (property-destruction + land-seizure stream; highest settler attribution)
definitions.broad_proxy: Mob violence + Looting/property destruction + Attack + Other (civilian-facing violence complex; the sibling report's settler proxy plus SD streams)
definitions.confrontational: Armed clash + Violent demonstration + Excessive force against protesters (predominantly Palestinian-confrontational / anti-raid activity; attribution diagnostic)
definitions.idf_combat: Armed clash + Air/drone strike + Shelling/artillery/missile attack (military-operations measure; interactional — counts operations met by resistance, not operational tempo)
definitions.idf_unilateral: Arrests + Disrupted weapons use (IDF-perpetrated policing/seizure activity; only notable arrests are coded, so this is a floor)
definitions.resistance: Grenade + Remote explosive/landmine/IED (predominantly militant-perpetrated; the mirror of the IDF tiers)

records.note: rolling 52-week totals are computed on consecutive week bins; the window ending at the last data week (2026-10-24) covers Nov 2025-Oct 2026; "pre-war"/"pre-cf2" maxima only consider windows ending before those boundaries, so they exclude any overlap with the current wave

seasonality.note: Oct-Nov = olive harvest; profile computed on 2016-2025 so the 2026 wave cannot dominate it

attribution.note: A near-zero mob fatality rate + near-zero confrontational streams (as in 2026) indicates the mob stream is dominated by settler rampages rather than crowd confrontations met with lethal force; a high rate (2016, May 2021, Oct 2023) indicates the converse. Cross-checked against OCHA yearly and ACLED 2026 counts.

see_saw.note: The settler complex is not synchronized with Gaza at the weekly level in any regime; its relationship to Gaza is regime-level (war onset spike; ceasefire-era compounding).

idf_streams.tiers_note: Combat = clash + air/drone strike + shelling (interactional: measures contested operations, i.e. campaign intensity met by resistance, not operational tempo). Unilateral = arrests + disrupted weapons use (purely IDF-perpetrated but only notable arrests are coded — a floor, not a tempo). Resistance = grenade + IED (predominantly militant-perpetrated).

handoff.note: Rolling 52-week comparison of the settler core proxy vs the IDF combat tier. The dated first crossing is the "handoff": the point from which the settler stream out-runs military operations in the event data.

validation.fatalities_note: Combat-tier fatalities (clash + strike + shelling) track the shape of OCHA's actor-verified "by Israeli forces" attribution; the remainder of by-forces killings sits in the mixed VAC Attack stream, so the combat tier is a lower bound on by-forces fatalities.
